steps.content: Pepper's whereabouts are unknown and even your connection is lost. This child must know something...
You continue feeling the unresponsive shackles inside your body, while collapsing into Oliver's palm as a sightless doll, buying yourself some time to think.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Why won't you answer me? That's not right, the toys in Eve's factory are supposed to be alive~

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Could I have made a mistake? Ah, what a pity... I guess I'll have to throw you into the shredder~
The kid named Oliver ravages the silenced screaming chicken in hand, and with a sense of superiority, Oliver picks you up and heads toward the shredder.
You suddenly move and grab Oliver's hand, but Oliver doesn't seem surprised.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Ah, you're finally talking to Oliver! I thought you didn't like me...

Oliver's clearly provoking you on purpose, but is now acting all innocent... You too put on your best naive expression, tilting your rag doll head and forcing a cute voice that Hella would surely mock...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What did you mean by all I'll find is death if I run away?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: I meant that, literally. Who says getting out will change you back? It'll only turn you into a motionless, lifeless toy.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: If you want to find a solution, of course, you have to find the root of everything...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You mean Eve, the name you and Bass have mentioned?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: That's right! A round of applause!

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: She's the one you're most curious about, the evil villain who turned the factory into this!
Oliver gives your cotton belly a gentle squeeze.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: You, sir, are just a pitiful passerby who got turned into a toy by accident.
steps.female_content: You, ma'am, are just a pitiful passerby who got turned into a toy by accident.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: As for this one...
Oliver shakes the screaming chicken in the other hand.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: He had always been part of the factory. Besides, he's also Eve's most important non-blood-related family member!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's why he was screaming "protect Eve"...

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: And you got it right again! Isn't it very touching? He still thinks about Eve even after being turned into a toy!

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Even though she's a bad kid who aspires to turn the whole world into toys, not sparing even her own family! Yet she receives so much love!

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Oliver is so envious of such unyielding familial love that it makes me sick!
Oliver says this with a disdainful and mocking expression.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If everyone here gets turned into a toy by Eve, then why has nothing happened to you, Oliver? And just now you did call her... your sister?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Hey, Oliver is being so nice and answering all your questions, but you're still doubting me. You must have mistaken Oliver for a little liar, haven't you?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: What if I told you that just like you, I was a poor innocent passerby? Would you believe Oliver?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: That ghost in white named Eve, she somehow just floated in front of me in her wheelchair. Oliver was petrified!

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: She said that only family were allowed in her home, and that her family could only be toys.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Oliver was desperate, so I told her I could be her best family member even without turning into a toy... It was a close call.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: But Oliver only managed to keep a flexible body, I still can't escape from this place... Oliver is so useless...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: White clothes, wheelchair, young girl...

steps.speaker: Scavenger
steps.content: A pale wheelchair-bound girl appearing in various corners of the factory.

steps.speaker: Scavenger
steps.content: Without exception, those who lay eyes on her will all...

steps.speaker: Scavenger
steps.content: Turn! Into! Toys!
At least this kid didn't lie about one thing. Eve. She's the crux of this place, and finding her could mean saving Pepper!
Staying in character as an innocent rag doll, you glance at Bass who's been tormented by Oliver and ask vigilantly...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're not telling me so much for nothing, are you? What do you want me to do for you?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Hehe, have you seen through Oliver's little plan?

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Then come on, if you want to save your friend, show me how you defeated Bass just now.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: It's time to prove your worth as my partner in crime! I can't wait!
Oliver puts you on the ground and steps back while holding Bass.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: I've seen him with Eve before, but he's even more disgusting in person...

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: They loved and cared about Eve more than anyone else did in the world.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: But still, they were turned into these things by their closest family... How pitiful...

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: I'm sure you can end this revolting farce quickly, Mr. Rag Doll. I believe in you!
steps.female_content: I'm sure you can end this revolting farce quickly, Miss Rag Doll. I believe in you!

steps.content: Oliver holds Bass up, looking into the darkness with a face full of excitement and anticipation.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Come on, Bass, say hello to your family from the past!

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Let him out, make him tell us how it felt to be turned into a toy by his beloved Eve.
From the darkness, a round object about half an arm in diameter quietly rolls out.
There's a realistic yet lifeless smile on the ball.
